sources.role: config discovery, save/state naming, SDL input sections (0.10.5; same pin as the Lunchbox controller contract)
Flatpak app id io.mgba.mGBA runs mgba-qt
Lunchbox pinned SDL contract: config.ini SDLB keys, GUID profiles, portable resolution

paths.path: ~/.config/mgba/config.ini (or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/mgba/), shared by the SDL (mgba) and Qt (mgba-qt) frontends; the Qt frontend adds qt.ini (QSettings) in the same directory for UI/controller settings. A portable.ini file found in the current working directory switches the config directory to that directory. SDL controller bindings live in config.ini: section gba.input.SDLK (keyboard key<Btn>), section gba.input.SDLB (joystick key<Btn>, axis<Btn>Value/axis<Btn>Axis signed thresholds, hat<N>Up/Right/Down/Left), per-controller profiles in gba.input-profile.<SDL joystick GUID>, and the preferred device key under gba.input.SDLB

paths.path: Alongside the ROM by default: <ROM basename>.sav in the ROM's directory; the savegamePath key in config.ini redirects saves to one directory (created if missing)
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.sav next to the ROM (or <savegamePath>/<ROM basename>.sav); multiplayer saves with savePlayerId > 1 use .sa<N> instead of .sav

paths.path: Alongside the ROM by default: <ROM basename>.ss<N> in the ROM's directory; the savestatePath key in config.ini redirects states to one directory; SDL hotkeys Shift+F1..F9 save and F1..F9 load slots 1-9
paths.naming: <ROM basename>.ss1 .. <ROM basename>.ss9 (mCoreGetState formats "%s.ss%i"; savestates embed a screenshot)
evidence: source:mgba src/platform/sdl/sdl-events.c F1..F9 save/load slot mapping @26b7884

paths.path: Optional. Lookup order: biosPath command-line option, then the gba.bios key in config.ini, then <config dir>/gba_bios.bin; if none is present or valid, mGBA falls back to its built-in HLE BIOS implementation (Qt default useBios=true)
paths.naming: Default GBA filename gba_bios.bin; GB-family libretro names are gb_bios.bin, gbc_bios.bin and sgb_bios.bin. Source CRC32 values include GBA BAAE187F, DS BAAE1880, DMG 59C8598E/C2F5CC97, MGB E6920754, SGB EC8A83B9/53D0DD63, CGB 41884E46/E8EF5318/E95DC95 and AGB FFD6B0F1/570337EA; official GBA SHA-256 fd2547724b505f487e6dcb29ec2ecff3af35a841a77ab2e85fd87350abd36570
evidence: source:mgba src/gba/core.c _GBACoreInit BIOS lookup chain ending in mCoreConfigDirectory() + "gba_bios.bin" @26b7884
docs:mgba README.md "A built-in BIOS implementation, and ability to load external BIOS files" @26b7884

linux-flatpak.notes: The pinned SDL controller contract targets the mgba binary; the Flatpak ships the Qt frontend (mgba-qt).

paths.path: %APPDATA%\mGBA\config.ini (FOLDERID_RoamingAppData + project name "mGBA"); mgba-qt additionally writes qt.ini there. A portable.ini next to the executable (mgba.exe / mgba-qt.exe) switches the config directory to the executable's directory. SDL controller bindings use the same config.ini sections (gba.input.SDLB/SDLK, gba.input-profile.<GUID>)
